    customers.CustomerID

    AVG(Price) DESC 
LIMIT 1;

    CharterNum, 
    Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12) AS EligibleFreeK12,
    Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12) AS EligibleFRPMK12,
    (Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12) + Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)) / 100 AS TotalEligibleK12
FROM 
    frpm
WHERE 
    CharterNum IN (
        SELECT 
            CharterNum
        FROM 
            frpm
        WHERE 
            CharterSchool = 1
        GROUP BY 
            CharterNum
        ORDER BY 
            (FRPM Count (K-12) / Enrollment (K-12)) DESC
        LIMIT 5
    )
    AND 
    CharterSchool = 1
    AND 
    FundingType = '66'
ORDER BY 
    TotalEligibleK12 DESC
LIMIT 5;
